waivers.verdict: Hold. Nothing on the wire clears the bar this week. Jackson's IR eligibility opens a genuinely free bench spot, but taking it now would stack with the open Bowers trade and leave only two active quarterbacks against a lineup that starts two — worth doing once that trade resolves, not before.

lineup.verdict: Nothing left to decide — Jackson's zero at QB and the unmade Cleveland-over-Denver swap are both locked in by kickoff. Hold everything else.

trades.verdict: Keep the Cousins + Johnson for Bowers offer live with annaf23 — still projects better in every window. A fresh scan of all 12 rosters this morning found no second idea that clears the certainty bar.

inactives.verdict: Jackson was ruled Out after Baltimore's game had already kicked off — the QB slot is locked and scores zero this week; nothing left to do.

actions.message: Cousins and Juwan Johnson for Bowers, best and final. You're starting Watson and McKee in a superflex with 6-pt pass TDs. Cousins is averaging 24 a game and would start for you every week, and you'd have LaPorta and Johnson at TE.

evidence.note: Bowers was limited in practice Oct 21 (hamstring/calf), then played Week 7. He has played 84% of snaps over his last three games. His September knee scope cost him Weeks 1-2 only.

actions.why: Bowers starts over Kraft at TE; Cousins sits on my bench, Johnson becomes my TE3 once Bowers arrives.
